parsed.main_gap: A mistaken lcm formula creates a local inconsistency in the descent calculation; replacing mn/g² by mn/g repairs the proof.

errors.description: The equality is false: lcm(m,n)=mn/g, not mn/g². The subsequent conclusion P'=P/g is correct under the proper formula, so this is a straightforward local repair.

parsed.notes: Apart from this algebraic slip, the lexicographic termination argument and the primewise gcd invariant correctly establish both required claims and the stated formula for M.
